purpose: Versioned, domain-neutral state envelope for native-frequency observation adapters

field_rules.domain: one of domain_values; institutions_policy is an explicit V2 addition
field_rules.timestamp: integer or string preserved in native source frequency
field_rules.native_frequency: one of native_frequency_values; do not convert source frequency implicitly
field_rules.state_label: non-empty observed or rule-derived label at timestamp
field_rules.state_probability: null or finite numeric value in [0,1]; descriptive score only, not causal confidence
field_rules.source_observations: object containing source values and source-native metadata
field_rules.lead_profile: object; empty when the state is point-in-time
field_rules.evidence_refs: array of source IDs, versions or artifact references

rules: Do not use future outcome labels to emit a current state.
Preserve native frequency, timestamps, values and source definitions.
Do not impute, normalize, average across sources or force reconciliation in the DomainState layer.
A deterministic state score is not a probability of causality.
Missing source artifacts are reported; they are never reconstructed or silently removed.
Duplicate state slots are surfaced for review and are never silently deduplicated.
